PlaneApiSerializersMemberWorkspacemember.description: Minimal WorkspaceMember representation for paginated member pickers/directories.
The existing workspace roster adds a role to the API user projection.

PlaneAppSerializersProjectProjectmemberi.description:
Safe read-only serializer for the public project invite GET endpoint.

Intentionally excludes ``email`` and ``token`` so that an unauthenticated
caller cannot retrieve the invitee's email address or the acceptance token
(GHSA-2r58-hgv7-635q).

PlaneAppSerializersWorkspaceWorkspacemem.description:
Safe read-only serializer for the public workspace invite GET endpoint.

Intentionally excludes ``token`` and ``invite_link`` so that an
unauthenticated caller cannot retrieve the acceptance token and use it to
hijack an invitation (GHSA-86mg-259g-pwgg / GHSA-gf48-p6jp-cwc4).
